notes: Target is always the caller's own app_user.phone (never a request field). channel defaults to app_user.notify_channel (app -> call). at in the future -> status scheduled (buddy-callbacks-due starts it). Now: call -> POST /v1/agents/outbound {from: global MERC_BUDDY_NUMBER, to: phone, call_purpose: 'merc_buddy:<buddy_call_id>:<purpose>'} via service account merc-platform-api; whatsapp -> template merc_buddy_ping (free text only inside whatsapp_window_until). Call hours 07:30-21:00 org time; outside -> scheduled for the next allowed slot. Idempotent on (user, purpose, ref_id) for 10 min. Meeting loop (REQ-MTG-*): pre_visit (ref visit_brief) -> WhatsApp template merc_previsit_brief with the brief bullets and quick replies Call me / Useful / Not useful, or a call that reads spoken_script; post_visit (ref visit) -> 'How did it go at <account>?'; debrief_confirm (ref debrief_confirmation) -> template merc_debrief_confirm with quick replies Correct / Fix / Brief did not help. Inside whatsapp_window_until send the same content as an interactive free-form message instead of a template.
